name: FilterPanel
purpose: A record-filter sidebar with searchable checkbox facets, contextual counts, and collapsible groups.
description: An in-flow panel. The containing grid shell owns its push/collapse transition.

guidance.overview: A record-filter sidebar with searchable checkbox facets, contextual counts, and collapsible groups.
usage: Use the same controlled RecordFilterState as the toolbar and data query. Values are ORed within a facet and ANDed across facets and rules.
Facet counts apply the other filters while excluding their own facet, so users can see meaningful alternative choices.
FilterOptions shows the first eight options, then Show all or Show less. Collapsing a long group does not clear its selected values.
accessibility: Shared Checkbox and Accordion controls preserve named selection and disclosure behavior without category icons carrying meaning.
Show all and Show less expose the group name, option count, and expanded state. Keep the sidebar toggle and close focus behavior in the host layout.
context: Use beside a record collection with several independent facets; it is a record-specific pattern rather than a schema-free filter engine.
